items.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Same here, Monk, very pleased to be speaking with you.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and Hamilton College Performing Arts, and I’m very pleased to have Anat Cohen with me this morning, not exactly jazz musicians’ hours, but nonetheless I’m pleased to speak with you.
Same here, Monk, very pleased to be speaking with you.

I want to start out with an observation and a comparison. Years ago I was able to interview Buddy DeFranco, the clarinetist, who described the instrument as an “agony stick.” And contrasted with your website where the first thing you see is “the clarinet took over my life and I’m happily surrendering.” So I like that attitude toward your instrument.
